_ordering_rationale: AvalonBay = REIT residentiel premium (apartements cotiers + sun belt expansion). KPIs ordres: Same Store NOI (coeur portfolio existant), Core FFO/share (metric REIT cle), NOI total (incl. dev/acquis), Same Store Residential Revenue, communautes / apt homes.

kpis.signal: Coeur portfolio cotier: NOI like-for-like, recouvrement post-COVID puis stabilisation +3% avec demande locative coastal
kpis.description_fr: NOI des communautes Same Store residential (apartements deja en exploitation depuis 12 mois). Indicateur cle REIT: croissance organique pure, hors developpements/acquisitions.
kpis.description_en: Same Store residential NOI (apartment communities stabilized for 12+ months). Key REIT metric: pure organic growth, excludes dev/acquisitions.

kpis.signal: Metric phare REIT residentiel, base de calcul du dividende. Croissance >25% sur 5 ans
kpis.description_fr: Core FFO par action diluee (FFO ajuste des elements non-recurrents). Standard REIT (Nareit). Reflete capacite distributive recurrente.
kpis.description_en: Core FFO per diluted share (FFO adjusted for non-core items). REIT standard (Nareit). Reflects recurring distributable cash.

kpis.signal: Inclut developpements livres, acquisitions et expansion Sun Belt (NC, TX, FL, CO). Croissance >30% sur 5 ans
kpis.description_fr: NOI total (Same Store + dev/redev + acquisitions). Mesure le rendement operationnel total du portfolio, y compris contribution des nouveaux actifs.
kpis.description_en: Total NOI (Same Store + dev/redev + acquisitions). Captures total operating yield including new asset contribution.

kpis.signal: Cash flow REIT distributable, base dividende. Trajectoire +29% sur 5 ans malgre dilution
kpis.description_fr: Core FFO total attributable aux actionnaires (avant per share). Base de calcul des distributions. Permet de voir l'effet de la dilution vs growth.
kpis.description_en: Total Core FFO attributable to stockholders (pre-per-share). Distribution base. Useful to separate dilution from growth.
